text:
maria: FYI - after the console authz refactor last night a few customers reported slow dashboard loads. 95p panel latency climbed ~110ms on report-heavy tenants

owen: saw traces. root cause looks like authz moved to per-query evaluation in the query path rather than a single prefilter step. that multiplies auth RPCs per dashboard render

li: can you share an example trace? is it repeated identical checks or different resource ids?

maria: trace excerpt: \nrender->panel(1)->auth-check(panel:1)->fetch-data\nrender->panel(2)->auth-check(panel:2)->fetch-data\n... (8 panels)\nwe used to do one gateway prefilter and push a filtered query; new flow does per-panel checks in the query executor

nora: tradeoffs we discussed in RFC: per-resource correctness vs global efficiency. we intentionally chose correctness but underestimated fanout cost for wide dashboards

owen: short-term mitigation options brainstorm:
- revert to gateway prefilter (fast but coarse)
- implement batched authz endpoint (server-side, longer)
- client-side decision cache + coalescing in query worker (fast-medium)
- opportunistic prefilter for common panel templates (hybrid)

li: note on caching: TTL must be conservative. suggested default 20s for allows, 5s for denies, and log audit on cached allow hits for sensitive tenants

maria: goal: get panel 99p under 350ms within 48h. current 99p ~430ms for some tenants

own: my take: implement coalescing + microcache in query workers immediately (small change). parallel spike for batched API as medium term. reserve gateway prefilter as emergency rollback only

nora: agree. also add a tenant-size aware cap on cache memory and an overload circuit that flips to gateway-prefilter when auth sidecar is overloaded

infra-bot: deploy: query-worker v3.1.2 -> canary=10% :white_check_mark:

li: prototyping batched API: POST /auth/batch {tenant, action, resources: [{type,id},...]} returns map resource->decision. server should support chunking and per-resource trace ids

maria: rollout plan:
1) enable microcache+coalesce in query-worker for 100% (1d)
2) enable emergency gateway-prefilter toggle for top 5 worst offenders (today)
3) ship batched auth API as canary (5%) (2w)
4) switch client-side callers to batch + fallback (3w)

own: metrics to watch: panel render 95p/99p, auth sidecar 95p, auth mismatch/denial rates, and cache hit ratio. put thresholds for auto-rollback

qa-bot: added regression test to CI: synthetic dashboard render (12 panels, mixed tenants). will fail if 95p>350ms

maria: action items:
- owen: implement coalescing + microcache in query-worker (ETA 24h)
- li: spec batched API and perf targets (ETA 10d)
- nora: add overload circuit + toggle playbook (ETA 2d)
- infra-bot: monitor canary and alert on 99p>350ms (ETA immediate)

infra-bot: canary metrics recorded: auth sidecar 95p=220ms, panel 95p=320ms (baseline before change was 200ms)

maria: great. post numbers back in 24h. if 95p stays above 350ms we'll flip gateway-prefilter and prioritize batching work
